faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the RNSB Jr. Executive (Trainee) recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to submit your online application for the Jr. Executive (Trainee) position at Rajkot Nagarik Sahakari Bank is 08 September 2026.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for the Jr. Executive (Trainee) post?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a First Class Graduate degree (excluding Arts) or a Postgraduate degree (excluding Arts) with a 2-year course. Freshers with computer knowledge are also encouraged to apply.

faq.question: Q3. Is there any experience required for this role?
faq.answer: While not strictly mandatory, having 2 years of experience in any Co-Operative bank or financial institute is considered preferable for the Jr. Executive (Trainee) position.

faq.question: Q4. What is the maximum age limit for applicants?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for candidates applying for the Jr. Executive (Trainee) post is 30 years.

faq.question: Q5. How can I apply for the RNSB Jr. Executive (Trainee) recruitment?
faq.answer: Applications must be submitted online through the official website of Rajkot Nagarik Sahakari Bank or via the direct application link provided before the last date.

faq.question: Q6. What is the mode of application for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The application process for the RNSB Jr. Executive (Trainee) recruitment is strictly online.

faq.question: Q7. Is there any application fee for this position?
faq.answer: The official notification does not mention any specific application fee for this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q8. What is the job type for the Jr. Executive (Trainee) position?
faq.answer: The Jr. Executive (Trainee) position is offered on a contractual basis.

faq.question: Q9. Where is the job location for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The recruitment is for positions in Maharashtra, specifically mentioning Mumbai as a city.
